# Host and permission boundary
Use only factory-admitted macOS hosts, arm64 or amd64, with the exact preinstalled Python, Node, uv and npm versions declared in supported-versions.md. No automatic host installation or Python downloads. Setup and caches stay within the admitted worktree and temporary writable locations; network access requires existing operator permission. A packaged recipe grants no extra authority. Do not edit global settings, credentials or repository locks during setup.
